path_removal: Private absolute execution paths and training environments are omitted, not rewritten as original provenance. Source file identities use repository-relative names; the input inventory uses study-relative names. Original byte hashes remain authoritative.
scope: Diagnostics of the already frozen exact-reference realization, reconstructed with one PCG64 stream in array order. No new reference is selected on results. This is an atomic conditional law: inclusive coverage can exceed 90 or 50 percent without establishing miscalibration. Finite self-scores are not a Bayes floor. These diagnostics establish neither sampler convergence nor a mechanism for real OMNI scores.
